scope: Ten source-distribution asset PDFs and historical font-name checks for five EPS exports. The five EPS exports are not bundled in the lightweight public edition. No standalone font files are distributed. Replaced or regenerated assets require their own font check.
method: Read actual PDF font resources and embedded TrueType name tables or Type1 cleartext license headers. Subsets are not claimed byte-identical to complete source fonts.
project_license: Original project material: author-approved custom noncommercial source-available license; third-party terms apply only to their components
